title: The Forge

blade_trace.name: Blade Trace
blade_trace.intro: Draw the shape out of the hot metal. Follow the outline and strike at every ring.
blade_trace.instruction: WASD / left stick: guide the hammer along the line, at your own pace.   SPACE / A: strike when you are on a ring.

anvil_song.name: Anvil Song
anvil_song.intro: Work the metal to the beat. Press as each note reaches its ring.
anvil_song.instruction: Top lane: F / X pumps the bellows.   Bottom lane: SPACE / A swings the hammer.   Long notes: hold, then let go at the end.

one_heat.name: One Heat
one_heat.intro: One bar, one fire, one anvil. Heat it, then strike while it glows just right.
one_heat.instruction: Hold F / X to heat the bar in the fire. Let go, then press SPACE / A to strike while the heat is in the bright band.

streak: That is the rhythm. Keep it.
scorch: You cooked it. It is a blade, not a sausage.
Too long in the fire. Watch the colour, apprentice.
That smell is your profit burning.
cold: Cold iron does not move. Back to the fire.
You are hitting a rock. Heat it first.

ready.choose: A / D or left stick: choose what to forge
ready.start: Press SPACE / A to start forging
ready.difficulty_harder: Above your level: every stage is tighter (difficulty x%.2f).
ready.difficulty_easier: Below your level and mastered: every stage is more forgiving (difficulty x%.2f).
ready.mastery_locked: Below your level, but mastery is still locked: %s

result.capped: Your hands earned %s, but this item is capped at %s.
result.retry: Press SPACE / A to forge again

requirements.no_blueprint: No blueprint exists for this item yet

crude: I have seen better edges on a spoon. A wooden spoon.
Congratulations. You have invented the bent nail.
My mentor once forged worse than this. Once. He was on fire at the time.
fine: It will cut butter. Warm butter. That is still progress, apprentice.
Fine. Literally. That is the word for it. Do not get excited.
It holds together, which is more than I expected from you.
superior: Hm. I only winced twice. Keep going.
Someone might actually pay for that. Do not tell them who made it.
Not bad. I said not bad. Stop grinning.
masterwork: I felt that one in my iron. Do it again before I change my mind.
Careful. Keep this up and I will have nothing left to complain about.
My old master would have nodded at that. He never nodded at me.
legendary: ...I have no notes. I hate having no notes.
Three hundred years bound in iron, and that is the best thing ever made on my back.
Do not look at me. I am not crying. Anvils do not cry. It is quench water.

anvil_lines_capped: Good hands. Shame about the head on top of them. Go and learn something.
You swing better than you know. That is the problem: what you know.
Quick fingers do not make a master. Come back when you have earned the rest.
